BBTTCC Heritage (v1.1, RFI-native). Menhirkin heritage: Igneous.

“Some stone was born yelling.”

Menhirkin (Igneous). You are new rock. The Shattering was your birthday. The land that stood up and began answering chose you because it wanted a mouth that remembered being molten. You run hot, you cool slow, and you are, structurally, still furious about something.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Menhirkin).
  • Size. Medium.
  • Movement. 30 feet walking.
  • Lineage Lean. Menhirkin does not grant fixed attribute bonuses; your background handles increases. Your heritage leans toward Violence in fiction and through Tier powers.

Menhirkin Core: The Land Stood Up

Shared across all Menhirkin heritages. Granted at character creation via the base ancestry item.

  • Stone Soul. You count as Large for carry, shove, and grapple despite your Medium frame. You have advantage on checks to resist being forcibly moved.
  • Hex Recognition. Once per scene, while you are on a natural surface you are directly touching, you may whisper a single question about the place. The GM answers with one true thing the land knows.
  • Slow to Wear. You have advantage on Body checks against exhaustion, long-duration physical wear, forced marches, climate exposure, and sustained labor. You do not tire the way softer things tire.
  • Heavy Presence. Your weight and settledness are perceptible. Creatures within 10 feet of you know you are there even if they cannot see you; you have disadvantage on Intrigue (Stealth) checks unless you are on or in stone.

Igneous Traits

  • Heat Memory. When you take energy damage with the fire flavor, you may bank that damage. Before your next Soma Break, you may spend the banked heat as a bonus action to add +1d10 exploding energy damage (flavor: fire) to your next weapon attack, unarmed strike, or grapple that connects.
  • Molten Bearing. You count fire, smoke, ash, and heated terrain as normal ground for the purposes of difficult terrain and footing. Contact with your bare skin singes paper and warms metal.

Strategic Hooks (Foundry / BBTTCC)

  • OP Edge. Your faction gains +2 Violence OP and +1 Non-Lethal OP at campaign start.
  • Hex Synergy. In Volcanic / Thermal / Industrial-Furnace hexes, your faction's heat-based or smelting operations cost 1 fewer OP (minimum 0).
  • Forge-Ready. Once per Strategic Turn, your faction may reroll one failed crafting or weapons-salvage check. The heat remembers the work.

Note. This heritage grants its Tier I feat via ItemGrant with a placeholder UUID (TDAzTMQwQQlQyoi5). After import, run the wiring macro to bind real UUIDs.
